title: Customs and Border Protection Officers
description: Investigate and inspect persons, common carriers, goods, and merchandise, arriving in or departing from the United States or between states to detect violations of immigration and customs laws and regulations.

tasks.text: Examine immigration applications, visas, and passports and interview persons to determine eligibility for admission, residence, and travel in the U.S.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Document validity check aided, human verifies authenticity

dwas.name: Interview people to obtain information about actions or status of individuals.
Examine personal documentation to ensure that it is valid.

tasks.text: Detain persons found to be in violation of customs or immigration laws and arrange for legal action, such as deportation.
Inspect cargo, baggage, and personal articles entering or leaving U.S. for compliance with revenue laws and U.S. customs regulations.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Cargo hazard inspection requires on-site presence

dwas.name: Inspect cargo to identify potential hazards.

tasks.text: Locate and seize contraband, undeclared merchandise, and vehicles, aircraft, or boats that contain such merchandise.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Spotting suspicious objects needs physical visual search

tasks.text: Interpret and explain laws and regulations to travelers, prospective immigrants, shippers, and manufacturers.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI retrieves and explains regulations; human confirms

dwas.name: Inform others about laws or regulations.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Institute civil and criminal prosecutions and cooperate with other law enforcement agencies in the investigation and prosecution of those in violation of immigration or customs laws.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Law enforcement info sharing needs trusted humans

dwas.name: Collaborate with law enforcement or security agencies to share information.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Testify regarding decisions at immigration appeals or in federal court.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Testimony carries legal accountability and live presence

dwas.name: Testify at legal or legislative proceedings.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Record and report job-related activities, findings, transactions, violations, discrepancies, and decisions.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain operational records in structured systems

tasks.text: Determine duty and taxes to be paid on goods.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Tax calculation with rules; human review

dwas.name: Calculate tax information.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Collect samples of merchandise for examination, appraisal, or testing.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Property info lookup from databases

tasks.text: Investigate applications for duty refunds and petition for remission or mitigation of penalties when warranted.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Legal research strong, judgment and accountability human
